name: BITEZ - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Strawberry Lemonade
description:
Indulge in the irresistible fusion of flavors with our new Double-Stacked BITEZ gummies! These gourmet treats blend the sweetness of strawberries with the zesty citrus kick of lemonade in a single delectable gummy. Crafted to perfection, each gummy is infused with a potent mix of Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP, offering a total of 1,000mg per piece. Each pack contains two of these exquisite, layered delights, ensuring a deliciously intense experience with every bite.

Strawberry Lemonade layers juicy Strawberry with refreshing Lemonade flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
